name: mothership-era3
description: Kill the era-3 (1983) Mother-Ship in round 10 so the next round opens in era 4 on the third start-rung bracket (rounds 11 up), vs MAME.
_grounding: PLAYER_ONE_ERA_INDEX 0xAD14=3 and PLAYER_ONE_ROUND_NUMBER 0xAD11=10 poked at f560, before the round-start seat copies them into play. Mother-Ship kill recipe: hold KILLS_REMAINING 0xAD02=0 from f620 (400 frames), so the game arms the Mother-Ship itself (MOTHER_SHIP_ARMED 0xAD0D 0->0xFF at f960, launched ~f1057 by setMotherShipVelocityFromHeading 0x46BA with the era's velocity arm); then one poke writes what a collision sweep writes on a hit -- MOTHER_SHIP_STATE 0xA8A0=0xF0 with MOTHER_SHIP_HITS_TO_ABSORB 0xA8A4=0 -- so the ship's own handler runs its whole death (field sweep, 3,000 award, countdown) and releases the round. Hit at f1150. From era 3 the ship turns four heading steps a frame. startNextRound takes round 10->11 and era 3->4 at golden ~f1380, choosing START_RUNG_ROUNDS_11_UP. Stick program from f620: ten held directions/diagonals, 64 frames each, cycling, with a fire pulse every 12 frames; the turns include 180-degree reversals and 45-degree steps, so every arm of turnShipTowardTargetHeading (0x1F01) runs, the one-notch snap included.
